Checked page 86 against its native lines: the page-range citation "(TARABAR; YOUNG, 2021, p. 14-16)" appears twice (once with a footnote marker glued on, once as the footnote's own reference line). In the native extraction, the visual PDF line happens to wrap immediately after the hyphen in one occurrence ("...p. 14-" / "16)..."), so the hyphen and the following digit are separated by a line break and are not read as adjacent; in our correctly reflowed continuous prose there is no such break, so the same hyphen sits directly against "16" and the number-token regex reads it as a leading minus sign. Both are the same real page-range citation "14-16"; verified against the source lines directly.
